source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.12.2, printed pages 283-284.

blocks.text: Sulfur dyes un organic compounds ki thionation ya sulfurization (sulfur dakhil karna) se banaye jate hain jin mein nitro ya amino groups hon. In dyes mein sulfur ke linkages (jor) hote hain. Yeh aam taur par kala, brown, khaki, neela aur green rang dete hain. Misalein: sulfur black 1, sulfur blue aur sulfur brilliant green.

blocks.prompt: Sulfur dyes kaise bante hain, aur kaun se rang dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Nitro ya amino groups wale organic compounds ko sulfur (ya sodium polysulfide) ke saath garam kar ke (thionation), jis se molecules mein sulfur linkages bante hain. Yeh kala, brown, khaki, neela aur green rang dete hain.

items: Sulfur dyes: nitro/amino compounds ki thionation; sulfur linkages; kala, brown, khaki, neela, green (sulfur black 1, sulfur blue, sulfur brilliant green).
